name: ART 3615
title: Ceramics: Wheel Work
description: Investigation of techniques and processes for wheel-based ceramic art and design. Extends student research, development, and realization of concept in clay and glaze. Projects explore a range of wheel-throwing skills, encouraging inventive approaches to material, form, and surface. May be repeated for credit with a change in course content to a maximum of nine credits. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
requirement_description: ART 2610; open only to Art majors, others by instructor consent.
